title.value: JANOS: An Integrated Predictive and Prescriptive Modeling Framework
title.justification: The title is clearly stated in the document's introductory section, confirming the main focus on the JANOS framework.
title.quote: JANOS : An Integrated Predictive and Prescriptive Modeling Framework

extractions.description: The paper presents JANOS, a modeling framework that integrates predictive modeling and prescriptive analytics, allowing practitioners to embed machine learning models within an optimization framework. This integration involves specifying prescriptive models using standard optimization elements and incorporating predictive models such as linear regression, logistic regression, and neural networks as part of the optimization model. JANOS automates the transcription of predictive models into constraints solvable by mixed integer programming solvers, facilitating decision-making in complex business applications such as scholarship allocation.

primary_category.justification: The content of the paper focuses on combining predictive and prescriptive analytics using machine learning models and optimization frameworks for business applications, which does not directly relate to any eco-responsible AI categories such as climate change, natural systems protection, or pollution management.
primary_category.quote: This paper seeks to fill that void by introducing JANOS, a modeling framework for joint predictive-and-prescriptive analytics.

secondary_categories.justification: The framework is presented for business decision-making and optimization, not directly aimed at sustainability or environmental applications.
secondary_categories.quote: Business research practice is witnessing a surge in the integration of predictive modeling and prescriptive analysis.

primary_sub_category.justification: There is no direct correlation between the contents of this paper and any sub-category within the eco-responsible AI categories, as it focuses primarily on a business analytics framework.
primary_sub_category.quote: JANOS currently supports linear regression, logistic regression, and neural network with rectified linear activation functions.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The sub-categories of the eco-responsible AI list do not apply to the primary business and predictive-optimization focus of this paper.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: JANOS allows for specifying a prescriptive model using standard optimization modeling elements such as constraints and variables.

applications.justification: The paper includes a demonstration of the JANOS framework for optimizing scholarship allocation in a student enrollment problem, which represents a practical application of the framework.
applications.quote: We demonstrate the flexibility of the framework through an example on scholarship allocation in a student enrollment problem and provide a numeric performance evaluation.

new_primary_category.justification: The primary innovation is in computational optimization and predictive modeling integration for business problems, not directly related to eco-responsible themes.
new_primary_category.quote: A key advantage of JANOS is that it automates the transcription of common predictive models into constraints that can be handled by mixed integer programming solvers.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper’s focus is not aligned with the existing eco-responsible sub-categories, as there is no mention or application related to sustainability or environmental protection.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: The key novelty lies in providing modeling constructs that allow for the specification of commonly used predictive models and their features as constraints and variables in the optimization model.
